purpose: The evidence commit is documentation-only; both clean browser profiles exercised this exact product and collector candidate before the evidence files were committed.

machineVerification.command: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "$(node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFile} from \"node:fs/promises\"; const paths=[\"docs/evidence/p8-01-studio-inventory/current-run/inventory.json\",\"docs/evidence/p8-01-studio-inventory/independent-run/inventory.json\"]; const records=await Promise.all(paths.map(async (path) => JSON.parse(await readFile(path, \"utf8\")))); if (!records.every((record) => record.provenance.candidateSha === records[0].provenance.candidateSha)) process.exit(1); process.stdout.write(records[0].provenance.candidateSha);')"
machineVerification.expectedResult: The evidence commit parent and both inventory provenance candidateSha values are identical.
